assessments.reasoning: The raw intervals anchor the two pages and include an encoded cover image resource. The decoded cover text establishes authors, tutorial version and date. The abstract explicitly identifies SetlX as the new language and original SETL as the language its design extends. The finding relies on text alone.

challenge.method: Resolve the antecedent after the authors discuss teaching with SETL2.
challenge.results: SETL2 supplies the teaching context. The design statement independently names original SETL. It establishes the authors' account of lineage and leaves compatibility untested.

limitations: The relationship is scoped to the tutorial’s identified language design; syntactic and behavioral compatibility need independent evidence.
